capabilities: Explain selected Japanese words and sentences with vocabulary, readings, and grammar points via an LLM
Extract text from a drawn PDF region using local OCR
Save analysis results to a dated Markdown study note
Switch explanations between Chinese and English
Run analysis through local Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible cloud API
extras: Desktop-only; the optional PP-OCR integration starts a Windows process and is disabled until manually configured. Also installable via BRAT before community listing. No telemetry; cloud API keys stored in Obsidian Secret Storage.
motivation: The README does not state the author's motivation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get contextual explanations of Japanese words and sentences while reading, especially in PDFs.

relations.evidence: The script creates an isolated Python 3.11 environment and installs PP-OCR.

requires.name: Ollama or a PP-OCR PowerShell setup

summary: AI reading assistant that explains selected Japanese text with vocabulary and grammar in Chinese or English and saves results to daily study notes.
